title: A teleprompter for a speaker and an operator
description: One reads, the other drives the text from a separate device.

blocks.text: During a recording it is awkward for the speaker to reach for the screen. An operator can drive the script if both see the same version.

quote.text: Downloaded this initially to use on a shoot of Clive Davis interviewing some legendary friends of his for a TV special. The previous TPT operator was fired because they couldn’t keep up with Davis’ edits-on-the-fly to the script.

blocks.text: Sync the text and the position, and mark who is in control. If the connection drops, keep the last state that made sense.
Edits made during speech call for a separate mode. The lines in front of the speaker must not shift unexpectedly after every change the operator makes.
